about.title: A few words about the pilot
about.p1: Computer Science student at WSB Merito University in Gdańsk, 3rd year. I specialise in frontend, but I enjoy working across the whole stack — from the interface to the API and the database.
about.p2: Main focus: Fullstack — React/Vue + Node.js. I'm looking for an internship or a job as a Frontend / Fullstack Developer.

offer.title: What I can do for you

items.title: Frontend
items.text: Interfaces in React and Next.js (and Vue and Nuxt) with TypeScript: responsive, polished and with well-considered animations.

items.title: Backend
items.text: REST APIs in Node.js, PostgreSQL or Supabase, data validation and server-side logic, as in OTO OKO.

items.title: Mobile
items.text: React Native and Expo apps that work offline: a local SQLite database, a message queue and sync, as in Backstage.

items.title: Teamwork
items.text: I work in teams of four: Git, code review and clean architecture. In Backstage I lead the team and look after testing.

items.title: Studies begin
items.text: Computer Science at WSB Merito University in Gdańsk.

axel.name: AXEL
axel.desc: A local, multi-agent coding assistant — runs entirely on your own hardware, with no external model APIs.
axel.shotAlt: AXEL home screen with the conversation list, the assistant orb and the message box
axel.summary: A local, multi-agent coding assistant. It runs entirely on my own hardware, with no external model APIs.
axel.role: Project author: idea, architecture and implementation.
features: Assistant chat, conversation list and history
Dashboard, code sandbox, terminal and plugins
Quick actions: code, questions, web, mail, git and screenshot
Models run locally through Ollama, everything in Docker

oto.name: OTO OKO
oto.desc: A booking app for an optician's salon — engineering thesis, 4-person team. I'm responsible for the backend: Supabase, REST API, notifications.
oto.shotAlt: Home page of the OTO OKO optician salon with the headline "Your eyes deserve the best"
oto.alt: Home page of the OTO OKO optician salon
oto.summary: A booking app for the OTOOKO optician's salon, with a site presenting the salon and online appointment booking.
oto.role: I'm responsible for the backend: Supabase, REST API and notifications.
features: Online appointment booking from the salon's site
Backend on Supabase and a REST API
Salon site: about, services, news, gallery, contact

bs.name: Backstage
bs.desc: An offline-first festival companion for all the festival fanatics: the map, schedule and crew messages work without a signal.
bs.summary: An offline-first festival companion for all the festival fanatics. The demo runs on a fictional event in Gdańsk, "Stocznia Sound 2027", with data from the CKAN and TRISTAR APIs.
bs.role: Team lead and Domain & QA Lead: domain model, business rules, use cases, DI, tests and architecture review.
features: Download the event pack to the device
A compass pointing the way back to your tent
Crew messages with an Outbox queue, even without a signal
Badges: Prepared, Night Owl, All 3 Days, Three Stages

wp.summary: A recreation of a news portal as a course project.
wp.role: I'm responsible for the functionality (weather widget, search) and part of the UI.
features: Navigation by section: news, sport, business, tech, motoring and more
Ad slots in the portal layout
